column1: # SilikOS: the USB devices SilikOS knows (silik doctor bench, silik dev can list). One device per line, tab-separated.
# id: VID:PID, VID:* (every product of the vendor) or product=GLOB (the USB product name, as udev's ATTRS{product})
# kind: can (a CAN interface through a kernel driver), can-slcan (a serial port that slcand makes one), serial,
#   probe (debug probe), logic (logic analyser), vm (no Linux driver: for the Windows VM)
# driver: the kernel module that binds it, or the program that opens it through libusb
# use: what to run; IFACE / TTY / PART / VID:PID are filled in by silik doctor

# el9: yes = the ID is in the module's aliases of EL 9.8's kernel (kernel-modules{,-core,-extra} 5.14.0-687.66.2.el9_8, read 2026-11-12); class = the module binds by USB class (cdc_acm); - not a kernel driver
# verified: yes when a real device was plugged into SilikOS and used; no = [A]: only read from the source
# date: when the row was last checked against its source
# source: where the ID was read (a kernel driver's table, an upstream project's udev rules or firmware)
